versions.name: Patch 1.6.2 (Classic Escalation)
versions.description: Classic Dauntless Escalation era with original cell socket types (Power, Technique, Defence, Mobility, Utility) and no omnicells.

versions.name: Patch 1.12.0 (Reforged Mid-Era)
versions.description: Mid-Reforged update introducing the revised cell socket categories (Brutality, Finesse, Fortitude, Alacrity, Insight) and Omnicells.

versions.name: Patch 1.14.7 (Reforged Final)
